export SPRINTCTL_BACKEND=served SPRINTCTL_VUORO_PROFILE=/projects/dev/agentops/environment-record/profiles/workstation-vuoro-shared.json; D=$(cat <<'EOF'
Repo: agentops
Tier: fast-build
Problem: Picking up a handoff is manual. ~/continue was assembled by hand on 2026-09-19 and almost overwrote a live, unacked handoff from another track (2026-09-19-s3-d14-closed-next-s6). There is no view of which handoffs are still open across tracks. The launch command assumes `cd /projects/dev/agentops`, because the predecessor's cwd is not recorded. Multiple versions of the same track are not collapsed. TS-8 (2026-09-17 target state) makes the handoff checkpoint the continuation path: handoff/v1 files now, ledger checkpoints from S6.
Scope: In scripts/handoff.py and schemas/handoff.schema.json:
(1) Add a new subcommand `agentops handoff open [--json] [--write PATH]`, a read-only derived view over docs/dispatch/handoffs/*.json. It lists handoffs whose successor.session_id is null, keeps only the newest version per track (track, falling back to slug), and gives per row: track/slug, date, repos and their dirty flags, cwd, next_action, and a ready launch line `cd <cwd> && claude --bg --session-id <fresh uuid> "$(agentops handoff prompt <file>)"`. `--write` renders all rows to PATH, for example ~/continue, atomically.
(2) `create` records the optional fields `origin.cwd` (default: the process cwd) and `track` (default: slug). Both are optional in the schema, so v1 files stay valid.
(3) Document the command in the handoff skill (/projects/dev/.claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md, step 5) as the pickup path.
Not in scope: no new store, no sprintctl changes, no ledger work (S6 replaces the file source with a ledger query, and the output format should stay stable across that switch), and no changes to ack/validate semantics.
Acceptance: `agentops handoff open` lists exactly the unacked handoffs, newest version per track. An acked handoff and a superseded version never appear. The launch line uses the recorded cwd. `--write` output is regenerated, never appended, and a handoff from another track is always included. Existing handoff files without the new fields still validate and list (cwd falls back to the first repo path).
Validation: python -m pytest scripts/tests -k handoff -q ; agentops handoff open (manual run against the current handoffs dir: the S6 and weekly-lanes tracks both listed)
Writable: scripts/handoff.py, schemas/handoff.schema.json, scripts/tests/test_handoff*.py, /projects/dev/.claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md
Blocked-on: none
EOF
